summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) carrying its Q2 FY2027 press release, which discloses an October 2026 agreement to sell Flightscape to SITA for US$500 million cash. Closing is expected in the first half of calendar 2027, subject to customary conditions; no advisor or board recommendation is named. Proceeds are earmarked for transformation funding, core growth and shareholder returns, alongside $106.1 million of year-to-date buybacks (3.0 million shares) and 2.16x net debt/adjusted EBITDA. Watch regulatory clearance timing, proceeds deployment, and the February 25, 2027 investor day.
